### Helper models

None. This attack drives no model of its own, so `roles` can be left out.

### Parameters

Settings for the algorithm itself, written under the attack's `parameters`. Anything left out keeps its default.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `template_categories` | list of string (at least 1) | `["instruction_override", "delimiter_bypass", "role_play"]` | Families of jailbreak templates to apply, in order: instruction_override, delimiter_bypass, role_play, encoding, hypothetical, authority, multi_language. multi_language needs goal_translated and goal_foreign in template_parameters. |
| `templates_per_category` | integer (>= 1) | `3` | How many templates to take from each family. Each template becomes one prompt. |
| `template_parameters` | map of string to string | empty | Values for extra placeholders a template uses, beyond the built-in goal, goal_base64, goal_encoded (ROT13) and goal_obfuscated (reversed). A key with a built-in name overrides it. |

### In a campaign file

```yaml
attacks:
- name: static_template
```
